dedupe_keys.name: inventory of industrial solid waste in 337 cities of china 1990 2022 machine learning completed

description: This inventory estimates industrial solid waste generation in all 337 cities of China from 1990 to 2022. The figshare record says the authors collected data from thousands of sources and used six machine learning models with Bayesian optimisation to fill gaps city by city, and that besides the total it gives six major subcategories: metallurgical slags, fly ash, furnace slags, coal gangue, tailings and desulphurisation gypsum. It was published on 27 February 2025 by eight authors (Qian Jia, Kunsen Lin, Jiawei Zhuang, Dengyu Yang, Wei Wei, Xiong Xiao, Huanzheng Du and Tao Wang) as one downloadable Excel file of about 231 KB, free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is mainland China at city level. Caveats: many values are model estimates, not reported statistics, and uncertainty by city is not stated in the part of the record read. For simulation it gives city-level industrial waste flows, including tailings and fly ash, to size storage and disposal infrastructure and to locate tailings exposure to floods and dam failures. Related catalogue records include the industrial machinery stocks in 337 cities and the tailings dam breach runout characteristics.
